description: Assessing Future Risk of Wave Overtopping at the Galveston Seawall under Uncertainty in Coastal Forcing and Changing Weather Patterns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arash Noshadravan, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). This project presents a predictive tool designed to assess and forecast sea water levels at the Galveston Seawall, Texas, with a specific focus on evaluating wave overtopping risks that threaten local infrastructure and public safety. By leveraging both historical and projected environmental datasets, the tool supports data-driven decision-making for coastal resilience and infrastructure planning. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-j6rf-nk92. Keywords: Reliability Assessment, Coastal Defense Structure, Seawall, Wave Overtopping, Gaussian Process Regression. Published 2025-07-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
